quick_skim.title: EventSSM: Causal Spatial-State Modelling for Asynchronous Events Event-Depth Estimation
quick_skim.abstract: Event cameras report asynchronous brightness changes, yet metric-depth supervision is typically available only at sparsely sampled reference timestamps. Aggregating events into frame-like representations simplifies learning but can obscure the fine-grained temporal structure of the original event stream. We introduce EventSSM, a causal spatial-state framework for event-associated metric-depth estimation using a recurrent memory updated by chronological event packets. To bridge asynchronous predictions and frame-time supervision, predicted event depths are geometrically transported using calibrated camera poses and differentiably rendered at reference timestamps. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate improvements over established event-depth methods across multiple depth-error measures. Controlled ablations further examine cross-modal initialization, temporal recurrence, individual state, readout, and supervision components, and packet subdivision. Together, these findings establish EventSSM as an effective framework for causal event-associated metric-depth estimation, combining persistent spatial context with physically timed state retention.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Event cameras stream asynchronous brightness changes but metric depth labels exist only at sparse reference frames. EventSSM updates a recurrent memory with chronological event packets for causal metric depth estimation, transports predicted depths to reference timestamps via calibrated poses for differentiable rendering supervision, and outperforms prior event-depth methods.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 事件相机以异步方式记录亮度变化，而度量深度监督通常只存在于稀疏的参考时刻，将事件聚合成帧会破坏细粒度时序结构。作者提出EventSSM，用按时间顺序更新的事件包驱动循环记忆进行因果空间状态建模，并借助标定位姿把异步深度预测几何变换到参考时刻做可微渲染监督。基准实验显示其优于已有事件深度估计方法。该工作为事件相机下的度量深度估计提供了时序一致的新思路。
